chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Verily upon the hump of every camel is a satan, so degrade it and subdue it for yourselves, and mention the name of God — for it is God, Mighty and Majestic, who carries [you].'

key_terms.اذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ: Mention/invoke the name of God — the prescribed dhikr when mounting an animal
key_terms.ذِرْوَة: The highest point, peak, or hump — here referring to the camel's hump, which in Arab culture symbolised pride and status
key_terms.فَامْتَهِنُوهَا: Degrade/humble it — actively treating the animal as an instrument of service, not pride
key_terms.يَحْمِلُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: It is God Mighty and Majestic who bears/carries — attributing the actual conveyance to divine power

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about riding camels and mentioning the name of God?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a saying of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) concerning riding camels: at the highest point of every camel sits a satan, so one should humble and subdue the animal and invoke God's name. The teaching uses the camel's hump as a metaphor for satanic pride, reminding riders that the true bearer of their journey is God Himself — a way of cultivating humility and gratitude when mounting animals.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Giyas Bin Ibrahim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said;

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘At the highest point of every camel is a Satan<sup>la</sup>, therefore degrade him and humiliate him to yourselves, and mention the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, for rather the carrier is (a Gift from) Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has stated this Hadith.
‘On the peak of every camel there is a Satan and you must degrade him before yourselves by mentioning the name of Allah, only Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious is He who carries loads.’”
